A '''copper sword''' is the [[Copper equipment|copper]] [[Weapons#Sword|sword]], crafted from [[Copper Ingot|copper ingots]]. It deals 5 damage at an attack speed of 1.6 and has 350 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/copper_sword.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which gives the item the stats listed below.

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/copper/sword</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Combat ===

It deals 5 damage with an attack speed of 1.6.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Copper Ingot|copper ingots]]. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Copper Ingot|copper ingot]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/copper_ingot_from_blasting_copper_materials.json}}</ref>
